NOTE
**Ready for review — CI passes and nothing the triager asked for is outstanding**

New: The author pushed 3 times, fixing the PR-number topic bug and the wrong test expectations, and reverted a fake Gitea fixture. CI now passes. Missing: the test fix is a separate commit instead of being squashed into the commit it belongs to.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "integration review", and assign laurynmm (or Niloth P, who has changed these files most recently).

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this? @Alexis211, thanks for the fixes. Before merge, please squash the test fixes into the commits they belong to, per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
